description: Call this when the user asks what the framework, the Executive Suite or AI at Work costs. Returns every current one-time price with its checkout link: Framework + Executive Suite, Framework alone, AI at Work seat tiers, co-branding and the Rollout Pack, plus the Rollout Strategy Session (a 60-minute call for Executive Suite members only, booked in the members area; no booking link is returned). For a specific seat count use get_seat_quote. Does not take payment or book anything.
